title: Former Cyclone Hakeem Butler signs with Broncos

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Former Cyclone Hakeem Butler signs with Broncos
sources.description: According to NFL insider Mike Garafolo, the Denver Broncos have signed veteran wide receiver Hakeem Butler, the reigning UFL Offensive Player of the Year, just ahead of their mandatory minicamp, which starts on Tuesday. Butler joins the team after a dominant season with the St. Louis Battlehawks, where he led the UFL with 641 receiving […]
